votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of December 10, 2024, and January 21, 2025, and the formal meeting minutes of January 21, 2025, and February 4, 2025.
votes.description: Approval of four sets of prior meeting minutes, covering both work session and formal sessions from December 2024 through February 2025.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 08 of 2025: Joint Ceremonial Resolution with Mayor Mendenhall Recognizing April 2, 2025, as Start by Believing Day in Salt Lake City.
votes.description: A joint ceremonial resolution with the Mayor designating April 2, 2025 as Start by Believing Day in Salt Lake City, supporting public awareness around sexual assault response.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future meeting regarding the Creation of a Public Infrastructure District (Convention Center PID).
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed Convention Center Public Infrastructure District, which would assist in financing redevelopment of the Delta Center and Salt Palace, and defers formal action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Accept and adopt the findings and recommendations of the Board of Equalization for the Central Business Improvement Area (CBIA-25) and adopt Ordinance 16 of 2025: Central Business Improvement Area 25 (CBIA-25) Assessment Ordinance, confirming the equalized assessment list, levying the assessment, and related matters.
votes.description: Re-establishes the Salt Lake City Central Business Improvement Area for 2025, creating two assessments—one for downtown economic promotion and one for holiday lighting—and confirms the equalized assessment list for properties within the area.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 07 of 2025 for an election services interlocal cooperation agreement between Salt Lake City and Salt Lake County for the 2025 municipal general election.
votes.description: Authorizes Salt Lake City to enter into an interlocal agreement with Salt Lake County Elections Division to support the 2025 municipal general election, including participation in the Ranked Choice Voting pilot project without a primary election.

votes.motion: Approve the consent agenda items: set public hearing date of May 6, 2025 for the Mixed-Use Zoning Consolidation Zoning Text and Map Amendment, and set public hearing date of April 15, 2025 for Budget Amendment No. 5 for Fiscal Year 2024-25.
votes.description: Sets future public hearing dates for two pending matters: a zoning ordinance consolidating up to 27 existing districts into six new mixed-use districts, and Budget Amendment No. 5 for FY2024-25 covering various project funding adjustments.
